checks.name: single_k1_k2_implementation
checks.evidence: KnowledgeRetriever is the v2.1 service boundary for both stages; K2 rejects the old boolean-only convention and requires VerifiedBlockingCommit with scene, artifact, content, and verification digests.

checks.name: replayable_snapshot
checks.evidence: KnowledgeSnapshot seals the compact decision view, selection, exclusions, conflicts, catalog digest, legacy selection digest, binding digest, and redacted security-event digests. Replay verifies the seal and does not invoke catalog search.

checks.name: untrusted_text_isolation
checks.evidence: The established security filter quarantines contaminated envelopes before selection. The v2.1 runtime view has only reviewed decision fields and source digests; the snapshot excludes raw text and untrusted source identifiers.

checks.name: director_conflict_ownership
checks.evidence: Conflict candidates remain excluded from ranking and are returned only as requires_director_decision records. K1 independently fail-closes mislabelled camera, shot, lens, composition, edit, and timeline knowledge.

checks.name: evidence_gated_promotion
checks.evidence: EvidenceVerifiedPromotion cannot promote without independently verified evidence, a verifier, and explicit human approval; promotion emits a canonical digest and never mutates the catalog automatically.

informational_results.name: a0_a3_completed_package_regression
informational_results.summary: 35 passed, 1 failed. The only failure is test_a0_release_control.py::test_release_control_has_one_legal_next_task_and_at_most_one_matching_lock, whose static A0-complete => A1 expectation contradicts the valid ledger state with A0/A1/A2 completed and A3 claimed. This A0-owned fixture is outside A3 path authority and does not indicate an A3 runtime regression.

architecture_review.authority_decision: Architecture v2.1 is authoritative. No architecture-versus-construction-plan conflict was found in A3.
architecture_review.runtime_boundary: KnowledgeDecisionView contains only the compact Director fields mandated by §7.2. Full selection data is sealed in KnowledgeSnapshot rather than repeated into a model input.
architecture_review.k1_k2_boundary: K1 is restricted to non-execution knowledge and K2 requires a verified, scene-bound BlockingCommit. The legacy metadata retriever is consumed behind this service boundary rather than becoming a second v2 interface.
architecture_review.security_boundary: Untrusted text retains no instruction authority. Quarantined material is represented only by redacted, hash-addressed security evidence and cannot appear in Director view or replay payloads.
architecture_review.promotion_boundary: The service records the evidence-verifier-human promotion gate but does not auto-promote media observations or mutate the catalog. Later typed media/outcome artifacts must supply any cross-case proof.
architecture_review.production_boundary: v4 production entry remains unchanged. No provider invocation, media submission, owner approval, or production switch was performed.

residual_risks.detail: The A0 controller test hard-codes A1 as the next task after A0, so it fails once later work packages have legitimately completed. Repairing that A0-owned fixture is outside A3 path authority.

A3 accepts only verified evidence digests and human approval. It intentionally does not infer cross-case repetition or platform applicability from raw media; those future typed inputs remain required before a catalog update can be proposed.
